extraction.name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
extraction.description: The Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS) dataset is a large multilingual corpus suitable for speech research. The dataset is derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox and consists of 8 languages, including about 44.5K hours of English and a total of about 6K hours for other languages.
extraction.creator: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert
extraction.inLanguage: en, de, nl, es, fr, pt, it, pl
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by downloading audiobooks from LibriVox using Libri-Light tools, downsampling the audio to 16kHz, and segmenting it into 10-20 second segments using trained acoustic models.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Read audiobooks from LibriVox and corresponding text data from Project Gutenberg.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, development, and testing for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Text-To-Speech (TTS) research.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Data augmentation was applied during training using SpecAugment, which involves applying frequency and time masks to the data.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Audio data was downsampled from 48kHz to 16kHz, segmented into 10-20 second utterances, and filtered to remove any overlap between the training data and the development/test sets.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: We believe such a large transcribed dataset will open new avenues in ASR and Text-To-Speech (TTS) research. ... Section 4 details the creation of train, development and test splits and limited supervision train sets.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: SpecAugment[24] is used for data augmentation in training: there are two frequency masks, and ten time masks with maximum time mask ratio of p = 0.1
